description: Search the string-transformation utilities this server can run (248 total, across categories like Encoding, Hashing, Ciphers, Compression, Data Formats, Analysis, Generators and more). Returns {items: [{id, name, category, description}], total, categories}, best matches first. Use this first to find an id, then call describe_utility for its exact parameters before run_utility. `category` and `query` combine (a utility must match both); omit both to browse the whole catalog. A category that does not exist matches nothing rather than failing, so take one from `categories`. There is no paging: when `total` exceeds the items returned, raise `limit` or narrow the query. Reads the bundled catalog only: no network access and no rate limit.

category.description: Category to filter to (case-insensitive), e.g. "Encoding" or "Hashing".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 50, max 500).

query.description: Search words, matched case-insensitively against id, name, tags, aliases and description; every word must match somewhere, in any order (e.g. "encode url", "sha256", "uppercase").

name: list_utilities

items.description: Matching utilities, best first, up to `limit`.

total.description: How many utilities matched before `limit` was applied.

title: List utilities
